name: ART
summary:
Out of the Frame is an eXtended Reality (XR) platform designed by FifthIngenium to support the tourism industry. 

It is the definitive XR shared experience for tourism, empowering tour operators and event organizers to create engaging journeys that captivate travelers. 

The platform seamlessly integrates 2D and 3D content with artistic locations and virtual tour guides, providing a compelling and interactive experience.
